name: HVAC Technician License
description: How to transfer an HVAC contractor license between US states.
longDescription: HVAC contractors are licensed by state boards with different license classes, and reciprocity is limited to specific state agreements. PermitBridge publishes an HVAC transfer page only after checking the requirements against the licensing board's own source.

faqs.question: Does Texas offer HVAC (air conditioning and refrigeration) reciprocity?
faqs.answer: Only with two states. TDLR's Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Contractor application states that Texas "currently reciprocates with Georgia and South Carolina only."
